invariants.name: Each merged session gets at most one boundary
Each later merge carries the boundary of the session before it
A decision row leaves the live rows only with a resolving ADR heading
The last session PR deletes the plan

carrier.contract: Each arrow reads or writes one plan artifact. A heading read returns an offset or nothing, a state read returns the paths of the plan state folder or a usage problem, and a batch reaches the trail file only when each row parses.

category.equality: Two heading results are equal when both are absent or both name the same offset. Two plan states are equal when their root, slug, trail and drafts paths are equal. Two batches are equal when their rows are equal cell by cell.

laws.reason: This change adds no composite arrow. Each arrow runs on its own from its command, so no composition operator, map, functor or monad law applies.

abstraction.hides: The fence mask of an ADR, the git calls that find the common dir of a plan folder, the tab split of a batch and the one append call of the trail file.
callersKnow: A titled ADR heading with a full stop or a long dash resolves in check-plan and in change proof, and a fenced or untitled heading does not.
A plan path finds the plan state folder from any folder, and a slug needs a folder of the repo.
A batch writes all rows or none, and a problem names its line and the nearest phase.
A boundary runs once and commits first on the next session branch, and a resume that finds that branch continues it.
A graduated row needs a resolving heading, and its handle never becomes live again.
abstraction.deletionTest: Deleting decisionHeading puts two heading readers back in check-plan and change proof, and they disagree again. Deleting planStateFor puts a cwd lookup back in each plan and session command.

alternatives.name: A separate plan PR after each session merge
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It costs one CI run and one review for each session.

alternatives.name: A --repo flag on the plan commands
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It is a second form for one fact that the plan path already gives.

alternatives.name: A delete of a graduated row
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The base check reads only the base, so a deleted top row frees its number.

omitted: The model takes the push of a branch and the result of git fetch as true observations.
The trail batch, the nearest phase and the plan state folder have no model state. The tests examine them.
The skill text tells an agent what to do. Review and the boundary control examine that text, and the model does not show that an agent follows it.

bounds: Three sessions, two decision rows and four heading forms.
Each order of the merge, boundary, resume, ADR write and graduate steps.

negative.defect: A check that drops the heading test lets a row leave the live rows with an ADR heading that does not resolve.

limits: The finite model covers three sessions and two rows, and it takes git observations as true.
The model does not show that the TypeScript code or an agent refines it. The linked controls and review examine that relation.
The span function of B13 step 4 is not part of this change, because it waits for B09/S1.
Exact-head CI, review and every ordinary gate stay required.
